text:
Marta Gomez: Hi all, first morning at Redwood! I'm stuck on the Okta step  it says 'Confirm phone number' but when I click send SMS nothing happens. Anyone know who to ping?
IT Helpdesk: Welcome Marta. Can you confirm country code and last 2 digits of your number in DM? Also try clearing browser cookies or use incognito, sometimes Okta flow gets stuck.
Marta Gomez: DM sent with +34 and digits 45. Incognito didn't help.
Nora (People Ops): Adding @IT Helpdesk and @Connor. Marta, did you receive the 1Password invite? We sent it earlier this morning.
Marta Gomez: No invite in inbox. Checked spam too.
IT Helpdesk: Ok reviewing. Looks like your user was provisioned but 1Password invite bounced due to a typo in the email alias used (marta.gomez@redwood.es vs .com). Fixing now, reissuing invite.
Connor (Eng Lead): Passkeys are enabled but if you prefer you can add a phone as backup. We recommend Okta Verify on iOS/Android for reliability. For GitHub access, you'll need to add SSH key to 1Password item after you accept the invite.
Marta Gomez: Got the corrected 1Password invite and accepted. The Okta flow still shows 'pending SMS'.
IT Helpdesk: Temporary workaround: I've enabled email backup codes on your account and sent one. Use it to finish enrollment and then register a passkey on your Mac (System Preferences > Passwords > Add passkey).
Marta Gomez: Used the backup code and enrolled a passkey. I also set up 1Password and uploaded my SSH pubkey. Cloned the repo fine. Thank you!
Onboard Bot: Checklist updates: '1Password accepted', 'Okta MFA enrolled' marked complete for Marta Gomez.
Nora (People Ops): Welcome again, Marta! We'll get the SMS issue to infra. If you need desks/access or scheduling a quick intro, post here and Connor will reach out.
Marta Gomez: Appreciate it, excited to get started :)
